sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM: a re-push of an already-correlated sam_request_id is idempotent
sys_atf_test.description: Once a sam_request_id has a lineage row bound to a RITM, a second push carrying the same sam_request_id must resolve to the SAME RITM rather than creating a second one — this is what makes an SDIM retry safe.

sys_atf_step.description: Assert test_mode is on before writing any fixture data.
Simulate the FIRST push: write lineage, create a RITM, bind them — the same sequence as atf-sam-happy-path.xml, using a distinct sam_request_id for this test.

Simulate the RETRY: run the same lookup the endpoint's clause 5 runs (GlideRecord.get on sam_request_id) BEFORE writing anything new, and assert it finds the row from step 200 with the SAME RITM number — this is the "already correlated" 200 path, and it must short-circuit before a second lineage write or a second RITM insert.
Assert there is exactly one lineage row for this sam_request_id — a retry must never produce a second row.
